Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from authlib.integrations.requests_client import OAuth2Session
import secrets
import webbrowser
import os

# Replace with your Okta domain and client ID
OKTA_DOMAIN = "https://your-tenant.okta.com"
CLIENT_ID = "your-client-id"

# Generate a code verifier and challenge
code_verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
code_challenge = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

# Create an OAuth2 session
oauth = OAuth2Session(CLIENT_ID, redirect_uri="http://localhost:5000/callback",
                      code_challenge=code_challenge, code_challenge_method="S256")

# Redirect user to Okta for authentication
authorization_base_url = f"{OKTA_DOMAIN}/oauth2/default/v1/authorize"
authorization_url, state = oauth.authorization_url(authorization_base_url)

print(f"Please go to {authorization_url} and authorize access.")

# Wait for user to complete authorization and receive the authorization code
redirect_response = input("Paste the full redirect URL here: ")

# Fetch the access token
token = oauth.fetch_token(
    f"{OKTA_DOMAIN}/oauth2/default/v1/token",
    authorization_response=redirect_response,
    client_secret=None,
    code_verifier=code_verifier
)

# Store the access token securely
os.environ["ACCESS_TOKEN"] = token.access_token

print("Login successful.")
